name: Global Mangrove Watch
description: Map and dashboard of mangrove extent, loss, gain, deforestation alerts, carbon, and biodiversity, by country or custom area. Built by Vizzuality for Wetlands International, The Nature Conservancy, and Aberystwyth University.
embedNote: No frame-blocking header seen; preview loads in an iframe

Software Licensing.note: MIT licensed, actively developed at github.com/Vizzuality/mangrove-atlas

Data Licensing.note: Extent, change, and alert datasets are free to download

Technical Accessibility.note: Web app with downloads and a documented API

Infrastructure.note: Hosted by the alliance; the code can be self-hosted with setup
